sanskrit_verse: गवां शताद् वत्सतरी धेनुः स्याद् द्विशताद् भृतिः । प्रति संवत्सरं गोपे सदोहश् चाष्टमे अहनि ॥
transliteration: gavāṁ śatād vatsatarī dhenuḥ syād dviśatād bhṛtiḥ | prati saṁvatsaraṁ gope sadohaś cāṣṭame ahani ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From a hundred cows, the calf-bearing cow is designated; from two hundred, the hired protector. Every year, on the eighth day, the milking process shall proceed under supervision.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from resource stewardship capacity
Causation arises through sequential participation in production
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with ownership thresholds
Restoration logic demands proportional engagement with productive assets
Consciousness alignment occurs through structured economic participation
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset_count ≥ 100 AND agent_is_custodian THEN designate_as_producer_entity
IF asset_count ≥ 200 AND service_contract_exists THEN assign_guardian_role
ON_CYCLE_COMPLETION OF 1 solar_year FROM contract_initiation DO execute_milk_harvest_protocol
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving agricultural or livestock-based economies, the threshold of 100 units establishes custodial recognition, while 200 mandates protective oversight. The Supreme Court must ensure that these numerical designations are not treated symbolically but as operative legal triggers determining functional roles within dharmic production systems.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established by quantifiable engagement with productive resources. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests through annual cycles and specific dates (e.g., the eighth day), ensuring alignment between natural rhythms and economic duties. Responsibility is proportionally assigned without punitive intent, maintaining harmony between human action and cosmic order.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Annual harvest cycle must be fulfilled regardless of dispute status
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Guardian role activates automatically at threshold breach
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Training and alignment sessions for new custodians
Integrity Reintegration Procedure: Mediated review of production records upon cycle completion
final_declaration: This ruling emanates solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma is hereby restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness stands as the ultimate adjudicator.
